lead_headline: 3 Margaritas plants flag at Northfield as chain expands; Park Burger's 15-year Highlands run ends on lease expiration

restaurant.blurb: 2 new leads today — 3 Margaritas Northfield (Stapleton, chain expansion) and Park Burger closure (Highland, 15-year lease expired).

liquor.blurb: Zero applications filed today — extends drought to sixth consecutive business day, matching longest dry spell in tracking history. Weekly total frozen at 8 filings, down 91% from prior week's 93 (which itself reflected June's 152-application backlog release). No status updates, no removals across 10,354 tracked licenses. Pattern now definitively post-maintenance: state processing has shifted from burst releases to sustained minimal baseline. August will test whether this represents new normal or temporary summer lull.

reputation.blurb: 56 mentions this week across 13 sources — down 22% from prior week's 72 but stabilizing above June baselines. Instagram maintained plurality at 21 citations (38% share), trailed by Facebook (11), Denver Post (9), Reddit (5). Notable pickups: Building Salt Lake amplified Alterra ski headquarters relocation story; Fire on the Mountain TAG Burger replacement drove Denver Post traffic; Union Station preservation feature sustained engagement. Week averaged 8.0 mentions/day vs. prior 10.3 — moderate cooling after July's peak but well above pre-summer rhythm. YTD 1,167 total from 111 sources.

subscriptions.blurb: Net flat yesterday (1 new, 1 canceled) — third day without losses holds MTD at −16 (−0.6/day). 90-day net steady at +91. Last seven days posted +27 net, reversing prior week's −16 deficit on strength of mid-week surge (11 new on 7/23, 10 on 7/28). Monthly shortfall persists as July tracks as weakest month since March, but recent acceleration suggests bottom forming. YTD +210 (+1.0/day) remains intact — August momentum critical to offset July drag and preserve annual growth trajectory.
